items.headline: Standard Nuclear wins about $7M ARPA-E award for recycled-fuel TRISO
items.what_happened: DOE's ARPA-E announced eight selected projects in the HORNIG program on October 29, 2026, slated to share up to $50 million. Standard Nuclear of Oak Ridge, Tennessee, was awarded $6,999,984 for a project to make TRISO particle fuel from recycled transuranic and uranium feedstock, led with SHINE Technologies. Its company release is dated November 2, 2026.
items.why_it_matters: This is a research-stage fuel award, not a fuel supply contract. A microreactor buyer should not count on this fuel path until it is qualified, and it adds a second recycled-feedstock TRISO source to the fuel field.
items.binding_note: An ARPA-E selection and award announcement. The award agreement's execution was not confirmed in the sources read.
